tracks.title: Số Điện Đứng Yên
tracks.genre: French chanson réaliste sung in Vietnamese
tracks.subject: A meter reader on a Hải Phòng back street reads the same widow's electricity meter every month and notices that the figure has stood still for three months; she has been living by candlelight since her husband's old lamp broke, and he starts leaving new bulbs on the step with the monthly reading slip, until she turns the lamp on again.
